title: Wheelboat
description: Adds steering wheel support for boats
body:
Wheelboat is a Fabric mod that adds support for steering wheels when using boats. This may flag any server-side anticheats, so usage on public servers is disadvised. This mod supports **Windows** & **Linux**.

## Version Support

I'll always be able to update it to the latest version, however you should probably remind me by creating a GitHub issue.
